## Rescoped on the maintainer's word: `rc` is removed, not moved · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-26T15:19Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- **The maintainer's words** (triage thread, 2026-10-26): 「现在只有 latest 和 next」, then 「同意」. The release channels are `latest` and `next` only.
- The Maintainer-action line in the body is updated: the sweep now **removes** `rc` on all 73 packages and moves `next`. It waits for #26196, which teaches `release-dist-tags.mjs` the retired-tag list (today the script only moves) and retires `cut-rc.yml`.
- ⛔ The sweep itself stays the maintainer's hand. No seat runs it.

## 18.2.0 reading: the release step moved `next` but could not remove `rc` · devx project thread · 2026-10-27T08:26Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- **The maintainer's words** (devx project thread, 2026-10-27 08:22Z): 「rc dist-tag 删不掉 立维护者卡，手工删」. This card is that maintainer card, so this comment points the manual step at it instead of filing a second card.
- [Release 40464600678](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40464600678) (the 18.2.0 `force` repair, job 122058101982), step "Move stale pre-release dist-tags up to latest", 07:18:57Z–07:21:00Z: `next` moved to `18.2.0`, but every `rc` removal answered `npm dist-tag rm exited 1: npm error 403 … forbidden by your security policy`. The CI token may move a tag but not remove one.
- Registry now, for example `@objectstack/cli` and `create-objectstack`: `{ "rc": "17.0.0-rc.6", "next": "18.2.0", "latest": "18.2.0" }`.
- So the Maintainer-action above has one half left: **remove `rc`**. #26196 has landed (PR #26394). From a checkout of `main`, logged in to npm with an account that holds publish rights on `@objectstack` / `@object-ui`, run `node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs` (plan; it should list only `rc` removals) and then `node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs --apply`.
- Done when `npm view @objectstack/spec dist-tags` shows only `latest` and `next`, and the plan run reports 0 changes.

---

**Plan reading for the remaining half, 2026-10-27 ~08:55Z** · cloud ops seat. ⛔ Not a claim, and nothing was applied.

`node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs` was run in plan mode only, from an archive of objectstack `main` `7dd5a2ffa9`. Result:

> 0 tag(s) would move, **68 retired tag(s) would be removed**, 0 kept ahead of latest, 0 package(s) skipped, 0 failure(s).

- The 68 are 67 `@objectstack/*` packages plus `create-objectstack`. Each has `rc: 17.0.0-rc.6 → removed (retired channel)`.
- `next` is already at `18.2.0`; the 18.2.0 release step moved it.
- `@object-ui/*` carries no `rc` tag. For example, `react`, `core` and `components` read `{ latest: 18.2.0 }`.

The same login can do the other maintainer-only npm step for 18.2 at the same time: `npm deprecate @object-ui/sdui-parser "moved to @objectstack/sdui-parser"`, noted on #25753. That package is still at `latest: 18.1.0`, with no deprecation set.

This card stays OPEN until `npm view @objectstack/spec dist-tags` reads back only `latest` and `next`.
